basic.name: Frag Launcher
basic.description:
Launch a grenade that explodes at the end of its path or upon hitting an enemy, dealing 124~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies. Grenades can ricochet off of terrain. Deals 50% less damage to Structures.

Stores up to 4 charges. Frag Launcher's cooldown replenishes all charges at the same time.

basic.name: Concussion Mine
basic.description:
Place a mine on the ground. Junkrat's Trait can be activated to detonate the mine, dealing 180~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back. Junkrat can also be affected by Concussion Mine, but takes no damage.

Limit 1 active mine.

basic.name: Steel Trap
basic.description:
Place a trap on the ground that arms after 2 seconds. Deals 130~~0.04~~ damage to the first enemy that walks over it and Roots them for 2 seconds.

Limit 1 active trap.

basic.name: Jump!
basic.description: Activate to make the RIP-Tire jump. Can be used to pass over terrain and Structures.

heroic.name: RIP-Tire
heroic.description:
Create a motorized bomb with 530~~0.04~~ Health that lasts 15 seconds. While active, Junkrat is immobile but gains control of RIP-Tire's movement.

RIP-Tire can be reactivated to detonate immediately, knocking nearby enemies back and dealing 720~~0.04~~ damage to enemies near the center gradually reduced to 445~~0.04~~ to enemies on the edge.

heroic.name: Rocket Ride
heroic.description:
After 1.25 seconds, Junkrat launches into the air. While in the air, he can steer the landing location by moving.

After 3.75 seconds, Junkrat lands, dealing 935~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies and activating Total Mayhem. 5 seconds after landing, Junkrat reappears at the Hall of Storms and gains 150% additional Movement Speed until dismounted.

heroic.name: Detonate RIP-Tire
heroic.description: Instantly detonate the RIP-Tire, knocking nearby enemies back, and dealing 720~~0.04~~ damage to enemies near the center gradually reduced to 445~~0.04~~ to enemies on the edge.

trait.name: Total Mayhem
trait.description:
Upon dying, drop 5 grenades that explode after 0.75 seconds, each dealing 250~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies. Deals 75% less damage to Structures.

Detonate Mine

Detonate an active Concussion Mine.

trait.name: Detonate Mine
trait.description: Detonate the planted Concussion Mine, dealing 180~~0.04~~ damage to nearby enemies and knocking them back. Junkrat can also be affected by Concussion Mine, but takes no damage.

mount.name: Summon Mount
mount.description: After Channeling for 1 second, gain 150% Movement Speed.

activable.name: Dirty Trickster
activable.description:
Increase the explosion radius of Total Mayhem by 20%. When Junkrat is Stunned, Rooted, or damaged by an enemy Hero while below 50% Health, he uses Total Mayhem, dropping 5 grenades at his feet that explode. 

This effect has a 20 second cooldown.

activable.name: Spread Volley
activable.description: Activate to make Frag Launcher fire 2 additional grenades in a spread. Works for up to 4 total charges, or until Frag Launcher runs out of charges.

level1.name: Tricky Shuffles
level1.description: While Frag Launcher has no charges left, Junkrat gains 10% Movement Speed and his Basic Attacks deal 15% bonus damage.

level1.name: Extra-Wound Timers
level1.description: The final grenade launched from Frag Launcher deals 100% bonus damage, and Frag Launcher grenades last an additional 2 seconds before automatically detonating.

level1.name: Blow 'Em Up!
level1.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Concussion Mine or Steel Trap causes Junkrat to deal 25% more damage with Basic Attacks and Basic Abilities for 6 seconds.

level4.name: Taste For Explosions
level4.description: Quest: Hitting a Hero with Frag Launcher increases its damage by 0.2%, up to 40%.

level4.name: BOOM POW
level4.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Concussion Mine reduces its cooldown by 10 seconds.

level4.name: Chattering Teeth
level4.description: Steel Traps will slowly chase nearby enemy Heroes.

level7.name: Bogged Down
level7.description: Enemies launched by Concussion Mine are Slowed by 40% for 2.5 seconds upon landing.

level7.name: Sticky Wicket
level7.description: Enemy Heroes who are hit by Steel Trap are Silenced for 2 seconds.

level7.name: Dirty Trickster
level7.description:
Increase the explosion radius of Total Mayhem by 20%. When Junkrat is Stunned, Rooted, or damaged by an enemy Hero while below 50% Health, he uses Total Mayhem, dropping 5 grenades at his feet that explode. 

This effect has a 20 second cooldown.

level13.name: Bombs Away
level13.description: Increase Junkrat's Basic Attack range by 1. Frag Launcher grenades fired within 0.5 seconds of using a Basic Attack deal 30% bonus damage.

level13.name: Ripper Air
level13.description: Junkrat is knocked back 50% farther by Concussion Mine. Additionally, Concussion Mine's cooldown is reduced by 12 seconds if only Junkrat is hit.

level13.name: Gotta Trap 'Em All!
level13.description: Reduce Steel Trap's cooldown by 5 seconds and increase the maximum number of active traps to 2.

level13.name: Big As
level13.description: Steel Trap now only hits Heroes, and Heroes hit have their Armor reduced by 15 for 3 seconds. Increases Steel Trap's radius and damage by 50%.

level16.name: Burst Fire
level16.description: Frag Launcher fires all of its charges in a continuous burst, its cooldown is reduced by 6 seconds, but it loses 1 maximum charge.

level16.name: Endless Nades
level16.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Frag Launcher reduces its cooldown by 1.5 seconds.

level16.name: Spread Volley
level16.description: Activate to make Frag Launcher fire 2 additional grenades in a spread. Works for up to 4 total charges, or until Frag Launcher runs out of charges.

level20.name: Extra Oomph
level20.description: Increase RIP-Tire's knockback distance by 80%, and its cooldown is reduced by 25 seconds for each enemy Hero hit.

level20.name: Puckish Scamp
level20.description:
Junkrat also gains the Ability RIP-Tire. Each time he uses his Heroic, it swaps to the alternate ability.

Passive: Reduce both Heroic cooldowns by 20 seconds.

level20.name: Cannonball!
level20.description: Increase the radius and explosion radius of grenades from Basic Attacks and Frag Launcher by 50%.

level20.name: I Hate Waiting!
level20.description: Junkrat always rides his Rocket Ride Mount, which grants 150% increased Movement Speed, but his Mount cooldown is increased to 8 seconds.
